evidence.title: Witness interview - Maria Ortiz (cashier), 2025-02-11
evidence.content:
DET. PARK: Walk me through what you saw.
ORTIZ: A man came in around 9:40, grey hoodie, asked for cigarettes, then showed a handgun and told me to empty the register.
DET. PARK: Did you see his face?
ORTIZ: Yes, for maybe ten seconds. He had a scar over his left eyebrow.
DET. PARK: Anything else?
ORTIZ: He left in a dark sedan, I think a Honda.
[end of transcript]
evidence.notes: Admitted as People's Exhibit 4 on day 2.

evidence.content:

[00:31] Subject identifies as Marcus Daniels.
[01:05] Grey hooded sweatshirt recovered from back seat.
[01:40] Subject placed under arrest, Miranda read at 01:52.

evidence.title: DA trial strategy memo
evidence.content: Strategy: lead with Ortiz ID, then DNA. Weakness: Ortiz only saw him ~10s; defense will push lighting. Plea floor we would accept: 6 years.

evidence.title: Witness interview - Maria Ortiz (cashier), 2025-02-11
evidence.content:
DET. PARK: Walk me through what you saw.
ORTIZ: A man came in around 9:40, grey hoodie, asked for cigarettes, then showed a handgun and told me to empty the register.
DET. PARK: Did you see his face?
ORTIZ: Yes, for maybe ten seconds. He had a scar over his left eyebrow.
DET. PARK: Anything else?
ORTIZ: He left in a dark sedan, I think a Honda.
[end of transcript]
